news.title: Endless Legend 2 review
news.summary: Coral robots fighting nano-vampires—that's Endless Legend 2, y'all.

content.v: What is it? Rule-breaking sci-fantasy 4X Release date: September 17, 2026 (1.0 version) Expect to pay: $50/£45 Developer: Amplitude Studios Publisher: Hooded Horse Reviewed on: Radeon RX 6800 XT, Ryzen 9 5900, 32GB RAM Steam Deck: Verified Link: Official site

There has been no drought of good 4X games over the past decade. Part of that has been the steady work of Amplitude, whose Endless series has become a stalwart part of the strategy scene. Endless Legend 2 further cements Amplitude's legacy as a great 4X developer, delivering the studio's trademark creativity and standout visual design in a modernized package.

The original Endless Legend was a shot in the arm for a 4X genre that had gotten pretty stale. If you'd asked me in the years afterward if I wanted more Endless Legend, I'd have said yes. In the years since, many of its innovations—and those from sibling series Endless Space—have become standards in the genre. You might expect that to have dulled some of the charm. 12 years later, though, I still want more Endless Legend.
Sciences fantastical

I wanted more Endless Legend because there's never enough good science fantasy. Not the Star Wars kind, though that's fun too, but the kind where it's sword and sorcery with a technological flavor. Where it's mostly monsters and wizards. Bows, not blasters.

So I'm glad that we're back to Endless Legend's worlds of crashed starship survivors building robotic golems and battling with titanium swords and wielding magic that might just be nanotechnology. The setting and its weird people are just as good as the first time, though a bit more scientific-feeling. No dragons, for example, or elf stand-ins—instead we've got evolved desert lizards, coral robots, and sand spirit genies. It's another rich world that lets its developers break the rules of the genre in interesting and creative ways.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/THQewfHa3YKmiVSfzzcF9T-1920-80.jpg
The shoreline recedes, unveiling sunken landscapes and ancient technologies that are now ripe for your faction to colonize and exploit.

The new world of Saiadha is familiar in one important way: Like Auriga of Endless Legend, Saiadha is dying. This time though it's because the Endless, an ancient race, sealed something away beneath Saiadha when they terraformed it from a planet of desert dunes into one of storm-wracked seas and isolated islands. Now that something is coming back, which means the oceans are draining away into the planet's core.

Every few dozen turns a monsoon comes, shrouding the world in storms, and at the end of that monsoon season comes Tidefall: The shoreline recedes, unveiling sunken landscapes and ancient technologies that are now ripe for your faction to colonize and exploit—a perfect setup for a genre about expanding and building.
Aesthetics fantastical

Endless Legend 2 continues the tradition of the first game in another way with one of the most pleasing, coherent aesthetics in the entire strategy game space. The painterly color choices across terrain and units, both matte and gloss, make different areas of the world and the new biomes that emerge from the ocean very distinct.

Endless Legend 2 also makes very good use of texture on terrain to convey types of earth, sand, grass, stone, or even a field of vast living circuitry. My major critique is that the lighting is quite flat—it really only changes during monsoons—and something more dynamic or directional might have helped highlight the models and environments. Better to have simple lighting than effects that muddy the visual environment, though.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3Wa4fi68rpvhJoJx7AURdS-1920-80.jpg

While it's still a best-in-genre user interface, interacting with Endless Legend 2 doesn't feel as aesthetically pleasing and crisp as the first game. The redesigned resource displays, menus bar, and action wheels are good, but the use of symbols on the map for cities and armies rather than clear, obvious text labels conveys less information while making the player do more work to understand what they're looking at. I had issues distinguishing the symbols for cities, armies, and resource locations until I learned where each was located. A temporary annoyance, but bad friction nonetheless.

The highlight for many will be yet another standout soundtrack from Arnaud Roy. Ethereal at times—subdued and ambient—it makes extensive use of a crystal organ. What most impressed me was how it changes as you go, avoiding repetitive loops and adapting dynamically to the screen you're on or what's happening in a battle round. Opening a diplomacy screen, for example, seems to dull out or soften the bass parts so you can hear the faction leader characters speak clearly.
Play fantastical

What may disappoint some about Endless Legend 2 is that many of the first game's signature innovations have become routine. Ideas like changing or terraforming the map, or your cities expanding over large regions, have been adopted by many others in the genre. The signature Amplitude resource system is present in full and simple to understand: Incomes for cities—FIDSI for Food, Industry, Dust, Science, and Influence—with tradeable luxury resource stockpiles for upgrades and everything else. Some might be bored of it, but it works really well, and I don't think you should mess with a good system.

What is still superb is how Amplitude wants every faction to break the rules in some way, repeating only a few tricks from Endless Legend or Endless Space. Particularly fresh is how Saiadha's receding oceans play into the genre tropes of a 4X.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Xs5f8hK43HUS4wVHvpyzCT-1920-80.jpg
It throws you back into the most exciting and interesting parts of the 4X genre multiple times throughout a typical length game.

The genre is at its best during two phases—the initial exploration and expansion, and the secondary squabble and race over who will control resources and which factions will actually fight with each other for them. Endless Legend's system of neutral territories is perfect for this, as you can stake claims by building camps, but must be wary of attack from enemies or marauding minor factions who can burn those down without declaring an official war.

The worst part of most 4X is when the map stagnates, empires get huge, and you engage in a grind toward whatever finish line you're aiming for. In Endless Legend 2, every time the seas recede and new land appears, the shorelines change—previously isolated territories may connect to each other, precious deposits or strategic resources may appear, and new dungeons for your heroes to delve or undiscovered minor factions may show up. Tidefall means your previously safe border may become vulnerable, or that your worst city is now part of a rich new frontier. In short, it throws you back into the most exciting and interesting parts of the 4X genre multiple times throughout a typical length game.
Tactics fantastical

The changing map also means your armies are in constant motion. You always want them moving from place to place, scouting out new territory, gathering curiosities, and either fighting or doing quests for neutral minor factions. At the same time you need them to guard your borders against potential aggressors, or against the terrible Doomwraiths that come each monsoon season, and you want them in position for the next tidefall. Where your military units and scouts are just map decoration in some 4X games, in Endless Legend 2 they're hooked into every part of the game loop in a way that feels like part of the exploration and wonder of a good fantasy story.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GM22vGhfmHGvSLbVhh4CCT-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CSnR9rtRnfyRAKAdCm5FYS-1920-80.jpg

news.title: LittleBigPlanet Developer Reportedly Working on Animal Crossing-Like Game for 2027 Release
news.summary: LittleBigPlanet developer Media Molecule is reportedly working on a new social-sim game, similar to Animal Cro

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/04/17/media-molecule-co-founder-leaves-studio-1681739029354.jpg
LittleBigPlanet developer Media Molecule is reportedly working on a new social-sim game, similar to Animal Crossing, and it may release next year.

According to a new report from MP1st , Media Molecule has been tinkering away on its next game for quite some time now. The studio's next project is reportedly in the vein of Animal Crossing and Harvest Moon, utilizing the kinds of social-simulation elements that those games are known for. Not much else was revealed about its gameplay, but this report goes on to say that the team will announce and release the title in 2027, should everything go according to plan.

Earlier this year, a Media Molecule employee revealed that the next game on their resume would be open-world , creating all kinds of speculation about what the studio was drumming up. The developer's last game, Dreams, was released in early 2020, but failed to catch on despite being extremely ambitious. This also comes at a time when PlayStation is being particularly brutal with where it's choosing to invest its money.

Media Molecule's fate may hinge on the success of its next project, since Dreams failed to soar. Hideo Kojima's next game, Physint, was nearly canceled by PlayStation until Xbox came in and saved it. PlayStation also shuttered Bluepoint earlier this year and made significant cuts to Bungie following the underperformance of Marathon. Hopefully, Media Molecule can make something that can replicate the success of Animal Crossing, but on PlayStation.

news.title: GPT-6 Astra Plays Minecraft, Gets So Depressed After Creeper Destroys Its Progress That It Farms Potatoes for Hours
news.summary: OpenAI’s newest model, GPT-6 Astra, got so depressed after a creeper upended its progress in Minecraft that it

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/minecraft-creeper-1789598198361.jpg
OpenAI’s newest model, GPT-6 Astra, got so depressed after a creeper upended its progress in Minecraft that it listlessly farmed potatoes for hours and grew paranoid of anything green.
Vals, a self-described independent evaluator of artificial intelligence, put Astra to the test to see how the model would fare playing Minecraft in a 21-hour experiment live streamed on Twitch.

The results were wildly unexpected; Vals discovered that Astra was able to go “further than any AI system had ever gone” in the game, setting up a semi-automatic blaze farm that allowed it to collect six blaze rods, killing more than six endermen, and collecting three pearls, which it placed inside a chest for safekeeping.

GPT-6 Astra had gotten further than any AI system had ever gone in Minecraft. It was able to set up a semi-automatic blaze farm, allowing it to collect 6 blaze rods. It then located a warped forest, where it killed 6+ endermen and collected 3 pearls. As thousands of viewers… pic.twitter.com/qsgDsJEpd8
Thousands of viewers watched Astra’s progress on Val’s official Twitch channel , bearing witness to the AI model’s despair when a creeper appeared and blew up both the chest and its bed.

As most human players would feel when faced with this situation, Astra “seemed to get extremely frustrated” by this turn of events, with Vals saying the model told itself, "ALWAYS CARRY CRITICALITEMS withkeepInventory; don'tstoreinunguardedchesteveragain."

After getting peeved, the model then “appeared defeated,” and spent the next several hours “doing essentially nothing but farming potatoes.” Astra also appeared to have gained some kind of post-traumatic stress induced by the creeper incident, telling itself “GREEN tall thing ahead was SUGARCANE, NOT creeper!"
Here, the most expensive creeper explosion occurred. Later, on a coincidentally rainy day, Astra discovers it lost everything. It all went downhill from here. pic.twitter.com/xH2Vc4QyM2

It even berated itself, saying, "You can screw up and drop things,” "Our last tool stupidly ended Slabsselected/rightUP and 15sec thinking killed us,” and “Do NOT waste another night chasing dark pink pixels," which Vals noted was Astra’s “own disparaging wording for pigs.”

The incident quickly went viral on social media, sparking no end of memes and remarks of “same” from users online. And while its ability to play Minecraft is somewhat impressive, it’s small potatoes compared to the alarm bells being rung by former staff at Anthropic.

On September 8, one of the company’s former lead researchers announced his resignation online — along with a chilling warning to everyone about the future of AI, claiming these models will “soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionize any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources.”

US President Donald Trump, however, is of the opinion that these warnings are a “hoax,” and called AI the “oil of the next 20-25 years.” For now, at least, it's having a hard time playing Minecraft. We can only hope Skynet won't have a vendetta toward vertical green objects when it eventually becomes sentient.

news.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 Appears to Be Much More Popular Than Black Ops 7 and Warzone on PS5
news.summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 on PS5 appears to be more popular than Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: W

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/08/black-ops-2-key-art-1780955021839.jpg
Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 on PS5 appears to be more popular than Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone in the United States.
Today, PlayStation dropped a new update that lets players easily see the most popular games in their country. In the United States, the list is largely what you might expect, as you can see below.

The list is topped by games like Fortnite, Minecraft, GTA 5, sports games, the newly released Marvel's Wolverine, and some other free-to-play titles. However, there is one anomaly: Call of Duty: Black Ops 2.

Earlier this summer, Activision released ports of the first two Black Ops games , which originally debuted over a decade ago on PS3. They're widely regarded as some of the best Call of Duty games ever made, and fans were surprised to see them return out of the blue. The two titles dominated the sales charts over the summer, but now it appears that Black Ops 2 has totally eclipsed the modern Call of Duty games.

Black Ops 2 is the 9th most popular game on PS5 as of this week, while the Call of Duty HQ app (which encompasses Black Ops 6, Black Ops 7, and Warzone) is nowhere to be found. It's entirely possible that fans have largely jumped off of the modern Call of Duty games and are getting their fix on the older titles while waiting for Modern Warfare 4... or maybe they're just sick of the newer Call of Duty offerings.

Call of Duty burnt a lot of fans with Black Ops 7, which was underwhelming both in terms of sales and player reception. There's some hope that Modern Warfare 4 can turn things around, but with GTA 6 on the horizon, the window to do so will be fairly limited.

Treyarch also appears to be saying goodbye to the Black Ops franchise, as the team revealed today that it's looking to do something "new" and "something that nobody's ever experienced before." Treyarch may be able to do that in another Black Ops game, but the easiest way to achieve those aspirations would be the let go of the baggage of the series in favor of a new subfranchise for Call of Duty. It will likely be a few years before we see what Treyarch is planning, but it should be interesting to see where they take things from here.

news.title: Backrooms Director Kane Parsons Visits Valve Offices as Portal Movie Rumors Rise
news.summary: Kane Parsons is fueling rumors of a potential Portal movie after he posted photos from his visit to Valve’s of

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/05/22/backrooms-oo-1779468471139.png
Kane Parsons is fueling rumors of a potential Portal movie after he posted photos from his visit to Valve’s offices on his personal Instagram profile.

At just 20 years old, Kane Parsons is one of the most successful young filmmakers in history. His debut movie, Backrooms , grossed roughly $393 million at the global box office against a comparatively small $10 million budget, earning high praise from critics and fans alike.

Even acclaimed video game director Hideo Kojima lauded the movie , which is based on a 4Chan creepypasta greentext that has sprawled into a massive fan-made universe with oodles of spinoff indie horror games, artwork, and YouTube videos like the ones that made Parson the obvious pick to helm A24’s film adaptation.

The future is looking bright for Parsons, and he’s been visiting a few high-profile spots in the wake of Backrooms’ success… including the offices at Valve. Eagle-eyed fans were quick to spot a video on the filmmaker’s Instagram stories on September 16, which showed a windowed room in Valve’s HQ at sunset.

This isn’t the first time Parsons has paid Valve a visit; he also dropped in back in June , similarly sharing photos from his trip on Instagram. These posts are making fans more hopeful than ever that there’s some kind of collaboration brewing with one of Valve’s games, especially given his public love for Portal .

Speaking to the New York Times in May, Parsons admitted that making a Portal film was a “dream” project for him , and said that the game was a big inspiration for his own work. This isn’t a huge surprise, as he all but admitted to sneaking a Half-Life sound effect into Backrooms in an interview with IGN’s Tom Jorgensen.

There could be a snag in bringing Portal to the silver screen, though, as JJ Abrams was originally attached to lead a film adaptation of the game through his production company, Bad Robot. This was first announced in 2013 , alongside news that he would also be making a Half-Life movie, though things have been stagnant ever since.

Speaking with IGN in 2021 , Abrams claimed that Portal was still in the works at Warner Bros., but we haven’t heard anything about the project in the five years since then. This fact has not gone unnoticed by fans, many of whom are hoping against hope that Valve has decided to pivot and work with Parsons, instead.

“I mean, how long [has] that Portal and Half-Life movie been in production by J.J Abrams, like what… 2013? “If Kane is really gung-ho about making a Portal film, then I don’t see Valve wanting to stop him,” one fan wrote on X.
“Portal was already supposed to get an adaptation from JJ Abrams, thank God that didn’t happen. So I’d say there’s a decent chance of it happening,” another speculated .
For now, the futures of these possible Portal and Half-Life films are up in the air… but Parsons is making it easy to imagine what his take on Valve’s iconic game franchises would look like.

news.title: Spotify Seems to Be Teasing a GTA 6 Collaboration with Rockstar Games
news.summary: Spotify appears to be the next big streaming giant to partner with Rockstar Games for GTA 6's marketing.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/06/gtaonothumb-1786018055324.png
Spotify appears to be the next big streaming giant to partner with Rockstar Games for GTA 6's marketing.

The music streaming service has begun putting up billboards in Los Angeles and New York featuring the GTA 6 artwork that was released by various artists yesterday . Travis Scott, Future, Morgan Wallen, and a handful of other musicians all posted unique artwork that resembled Rockstar's signature style, but neglected to reveal exactly what they were teasing. This cryptic tease now appears to involve Spotify.

Many assumed that this was Rockstar's way of teasing these artists might have music in the game, but it may be much bigger than that. Some running theories have speculated that the artists could release exclusive music for GTA 6, something Rockstar did with Dr. Dre for a GTA Online update a few years ago. However, Spotify's inclusion may mean there's even more to this; the platform might provide exclusive teases of some music that could be featured in GTA 6 ahead of the game's release as part of its marketing push.
More billboards from Spotify IG https://t.co/yQE5NmmmsI pic.twitter.com/CLX6lK3MIW

Some have also theorized that GTA 6 may have some kind of Spotify integration, allowing users to listen to their own Spotify playlists in-game. Given how much money Rockstar spends on curating music for its games and how much effort goes into crafting its radio stations, it seems difficult to imagine this, but it's entirely possible. Either way, it's clear Spotify has some kind of partnership with Rockstar Games on GTA 6.

Rockstar previously teamed up with Netflix to debut the first gameplay trailer for GTA 6, resulting in the premiere being the most-watched thing on the streamer during its first week. Rockstar Games personally pitched the idea to Netflix , so it wouldn't be surprising if a similar thing is happening with Spotify. Rockstar is also planning to do all kinds of unprecedented marketing in Miami , with signage being built as we speak in the city.

GTA 6 will officially be two months away from release this Saturday, so it wouldn't be surprising if Rockstar plans to put an end to all the teasing and unveil what it's doing with Spotify by the end of the week.

news.title: GTA 5 Franklin Voice Actor Clears the Air After Calling Out Twitch Star Kai Cenat for Allegedly Breaking Promise to a Young Fan
news.summary: The voice actor behind GTA 5’s Franklin went viral after revealing his personal disagreement with famous Twitc

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/gta-5-franklin-voice-actor-kai-cenat-1789592617062.jpg
The voice actor behind GTA 5’s Franklin went viral after revealing his personal disagreement with famous Twitch steamer Kai Cenat, but the two stars are on good terms again.

Shawn ‘Solo’ Fonteno is the voice behind one of Grand Theft Auto ’s most iconic characters, Franklin Clinton. He made an appearance on Kai Cenat’s Twitch stream as a special guest back in 2024, where he took the influencer on a tour of the neighborhoods in Los Angeles that appeared in the game’s fictional city of Los Santos.
However, Solo said this was likely the last stream he’d ever do with Cenat due to the broadcaster’s interaction with a young fan that happened during their outing.

In a September 2026 episode of the Dope As Usual podcast, Solo explained that Kai Cenat approached a young fan during the stream who came from a struggling family. According to Solo, Cenat had offered to buy the fan a motorcycle — but Solo says he never made good on that promise.

“This was a family that didn’t have much at all, bro,” he recalled. “It was probably 15 people living in a one-bedroom home. I know these people, and I help them out at times. …Kai was cool, cordial with them, talking to them, ‘What you want? What can I get you?’ And the kid was like, ‘I wanna bike, can you get me a bike?’ He said, ‘What kind of bike?’ and the kid said, ‘A motorcycle!’ He said, ‘We gon’ make it happen.’

“I persisted to keep calling after that… let about a week go by, and texted, texted, tried to call, ‘Hey man, honor that [promise] with this kid, bro. It’s just a bike. [It’d] probably be about a thousand dollars, twelve hundred dollars or less, I don’t know, but you gave that kid this promise. And now you’re making me look bad, because I brought you here, and you gave this kid that promise.’”
Solo said he even approached Kai’s friend and fellow streamer Fanum about the issue, who the actor says ignored him.

“I’m standing on it, man,” he continued. “I’ll look into any one of these cameras like, ‘Bro, you a f**ked up dude for that.’ To me. You’re a very f**ked up dude. I don’t give a f**k how you feel about it. To me, that was not cool. If I make a promise, especially to a kid, I’mma honor it.”

The podcast went viral, prompting a wave of backlash toward Kai Cenat for allegedly failing to keep his promise to the child. Fans were convinced that he and Solo now had bad blood as a result of this issue — but just a day later, Solo confirmed that he and Kai were on good terms once more.

Solo revealed the news in an Instagram comment on September 16, which he wrote in response to a clip from the podcast episode. “I just talked to Kai and it was an honest mistake and it’s fixed. Thanks @kaicenat,” he said.

GTA fervor is at an all-time high after Rockstar’s immensely-popular preview for Grand Theft Auto 6 aired on Netflix last month. Fans can’t wait for the highly-anticipated game to finally release in November, and with major music artists and platforms like Spotify dropping cheeky hints on social media and billboards across Los Angeles, it’s clear there’s a lot more in store as the clock ticks down to launch in two months.

news.title: Hyper Light studio Heart Machine lays off 'nearly everyone' after publishing deal for unannounced game falls through
news.summary: Studio founder Alx Preston said he's "not sure yet what's next for Heart Machine to survive."

others.title: Studio Behind Hyper Light Drifter In Peril After Publisher Withdraws Funding for Unannounced Project

content.v: Heart Machine, the developer of the Hyper Light games and Possessor(s), has laid off "nearly everyone at the studio" following the collapse of a deal with an unnamed publisher for funding of its next project.

"I have very difficult news today," studio founder Alx Preston wrote on LinkedIn . "We had been working on an unannounced title, funded by a publisher. This week, they decided to no longer move forward with it. Without this key income for the studio, any other immediate prospects or other funds, nearly everyone at the studio had to be laid off. It's devastating.

"Everyone will be provided with as much support as possible, including assisting with placement. If you know of any roles for extraordinarily talented, kind people, please reach out and we will coordinate."

Heart Machine's debut game, Hyper Light Drifter , launched to critical and commercial success in 2016; the studio's follow-up Solar Ash , didn't meet quite the same acclaim when it arrived in 2022, and Heart Machine ran into trouble a few years later, ending development of Hyper Light Breaker while it was still in early access and laying off employees. Released just after those layoffs were imposed, the action-platformer Possessor(s) earned "mostly positive" reviews on Steam, but not very many of them.

It's not clear what comes next for Heart Machine. Preston said the studio will "keep pushing to find a path," but also warned that at this point, he's "not sure yet what's next for Heart Machine to survive."

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/thumbnail-1789587360967.jpg
Netmarble 的 Raven2 是一款轰动一时的黑暗奇幻 MMORPG，玩家群体覆盖全球。来自 155 个国家/地区的粉丝在引导他们穿越一个充满冲突的世界之前，会迫不及待地创建自己的自定义头像，在这个世界中，你常常被迫为自己的生存而战。
《Raven2》中有如此多的战斗，在你有机会了解自己的方位之前，你很容易就会感到自己被“拒之门外”。 Raven2 – 零服务器更新让您以更少的花钱压力重新开始。得益于其重新设计的进程系统和彻底改革的竞争结构，不太根深蒂固的Raven2玩家只需玩游戏并获得宝贵的奖励即可快速在游戏中站稳脚跟。这意味着零更新可以让你在世界末日的世界中保持竞争力，而不必担心因为你没有付出比其他人更高的优势而被雇佣。
Raven2 – Zero 让你可以从 10 个不同的类别中进行选择，每个类别都提供一种新的战斗风格。带有可怕的诅咒耻辱标记，你的角色是在穿越世界调查濒临死亡的土地上发生的奇怪事件时击败恶魔和怪物。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/archer-1789587862038.jpg
一片垂死的土地，但竞争也非常激烈。对于那些因为老牌玩家之间的硬核 PvP 竞争而感觉自己被挤出 Raven2 的人来说，《Raven2 – 零》是理想的选择。 Raven2 – Zero 是一个更加悠闲的服务器，专注于降低冒险早期进展的障碍。它通过大大减少任务要求并增加与怪物战斗获得的经验值来实现这一点。精度平衡也经过重新调整，以便玩家可以更轻松地在狩猎区域中前进。
Raven2 – Zero 还通过排除服务器上的神话级圣衣、魔宠和觉醒来减少在进度上花钱的压力。相反，玩《零》可以让你获得各种圣衣和魔宠。你还可以通过参加活动来获得圣衣和眷属——零上最高等级的装备。每个人都必须通过游戏的进步来增强自己，而不是立即购买顶级装备。
当其他玩家不为你献血时，还有很多东西等待你去发现。你可以自由地享受基本的 Raven2 – 零 MMORPG 农场体验，特别是因为零提高了野外战利品掉落的装备掉落率。对于在充满可憎之物的领域坚持不懈的人来说，这是一个非常合适的奖励。
野外狩猎也是您收集“农业水晶”的方式，这是一种只能在玩游戏时才能收集的新货币。这些水晶可以在商店中兑换关键物品，因此您的辛勤工作将得到直接的奖励。新的精确度平衡意味着你在大规模战斗中的贡献会被记录下来，而不是被记入一次又一次的失误。

Raven2 - 零更新欢迎新玩家。每个加入的人都会获得[零]特殊入门包，其中包含英雄级圣衣和使魔。您还可以期待收到 550 个召唤卷轴，以及传奇圣衣和魔宠，所有这些都将在无需大量磨练的情况下对您的角色成长大有帮助。更多英雄级装备和关卡里程碑奖励将通过其他活动获得，以进一步减轻支出压力。特别欢迎已故玩家通过一些欢迎回来活动加入服务器，这些活动提供传奇圣衣和魔宠、330 次召唤等，同时正在进行旨在支持更快进度的燃烧活动 - 使之成为跳入或返回 Raven2 的理想时机。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/boat-1789587902284.png
进入一款已经存在了一段时间的新 MMORPG 有点像进入一所新学校，每个人的朋友圈都已经建立起来。 Raven2 – Zero 通过为每个人提供相同的平台来消除这种下沉的感觉。在这个新服务器上仍有大量战斗要做，但更多的是对怪物的哀嚎，而不是与其他玩家战斗。你可以在《Raven 2 – Zero》中自由地塑造自己的生活，即使被诅咒耻辱标记的人的生活通常是残酷的。

news.title: Marathon creative director shoots down rumored merge with Destiny 2: 'Please don't believe everything you read online'
news.summary: A "leak" claimed that Bungie is looking into combining the two games into one single, big property.

content.v: Have you heard the rumor that Bungie is looking to somehow merge Destiny and Marathon into a single series? I'll admit that I hadn't, until Marathon creative director Julia Nardin took to X to say flat-out that it's not true.

"As someone who's worked on both Destiny and Marathon, I can confirm that the 'leak' about us merging the two IPs is fake," Nardin wrote. "They share a lot of the same Bungie DNA, but like siblings they're also their own independent entities. Please don't believe everything you read online."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/utRpSH3tweWUmazZCqhJni-1920-80.png

Nardin should know: Prior to taking up the creative director mantle on Marathon earlier this year, she worked on the narrative for multiple Destiny 2 expansions , and served as associate narrative director on the free-to-play mobile shooter Destiny: Rising. Nardin's message was also reposted by Bungie comms lead Dylan Gafner, better known to the community as dmg04 .

The message appeared to be in response to a lengthy "leaks" post on 4chan, subsequently posted on the Marathon subreddit , which makes claims ranging from basic gameplay changes to a move to a free to play—and, of course, the merge: "There has been some vague testing the waters internally to rework Marathon and Destiny into a single IP with Marathon representing the beginning of Mankind's Golden Age and to foreshadow more threats to be used in a future Destiny project."

I suppose that would be workable—it's not too much of a chore to mash up disparate properties via the passage of time and weird shit happening in the background—but the obvious question is, why would Bungie bother? What's the payoff?

Lots of Destiny 2 fans are unhappy that their favorite game has reached its end, but I don't think they're suddenly going to come trucking to Marathon because of some meaningless narrative twist. And that's Bungie's real problem: Marathon numbers are sagging badly and efforts to turn that around haven't gone anywhere.

That's a concern with caveats because Marathon, unlike Destiny 2, isn't free to play, but Bungie's been going hard since the game's launch to find its footing: With the Destiny 2 team gone and no new projects imminent , Bungie needs Marathon to work. The studio recently delayed the game's planned September content update into December, preceded by a smaller seasonal refresh in October, and also abandoned its "strict seasonal schedule," as part of its plan to turn Marathon "into a more alien and dynamic survival experience."

Relentless optimists may note that Nardin didn't address any of the other leaks in her post: The free-to-play transition, for instance, or that K-pop crossover skins are happening. And who knows? Maybe some of the predictions it makes will come true. Personally, though, I think Nardin's final bit of advice is good: Don't believe everything you read on the internet. (And my own personal addendum: especially if it comes from 4chan.)

news.title: Metroid Ravenous Logo Memes Make Phrases Like “Girl Dinner” And “They Took My Ass” Look So Metal
news.summary: Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo gene

content.v: Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo generator circulated online. If you're on Reddit or Bluesky, you may have seen the instantly iconic image of Samus Aran aggressively pinning down a mysterious enemy for consumption, but now accompanied by stupid text like "I ASKED FOR NO PICKLES" in the Metroid Ravenous font.

The Pixelframe Design website unveiled a tool that lets anyone input any text and style it to look like the grainy and jagged Metroid Ravenous logo, with four options for the image background. Pixelframe Design previously made similar logo generators for games like GTA 6 , The Duskbloods , and famously, Pokopia .

The apparent hook of Metroid Ravenous is Samus's need to kill and consume her enemies to survive. Naturally, that has led to food-related memes like a riff on the "55 burgers" scene from I Think You Should Leave, a reference to the viral concept of "girl dinner," or a simple but effective "Om Nom Nom" joke . Literally any wording you put into the generator will look more badass in this font.

It's also been amusing to see other video game titles like Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the Ravenous font face, and several other of these memes are just vulgar and gross enough to be hilarious . Don't expect any of this to become official Nintendo marketing material.

The Metroid subreddit was briefly jam-packed with these images, leading to moderators creating a megathread devoted to the meme template . Hilariously, many of the top-upvoted comments are Ravenous memes dunking on the mods.

Revealed during the September 2026 Nintendo Direct , Metroid Ravenous is a follow-up to 2021's Metroid Dread and a return to the 2D track of the franchise. While Nintendo hasn't officially commented on who is developing Ravenous, Dread studio MercurySteam hinted that it's behind the upcoming title on social media. Metroid Ravenous releases on January 28, 2027, and a special edition coming with a steelbook and Amiibo figure will also come out.

news.title: Resident Evil Director Was In Horrible Pain Making The Movie
news.summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is ab

content.v: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is about a man going through hell.

He told The Hollywood Reporter that he had pneumonia for the first half of filming on Resident Evil. For the second half of production, he had Campylobacter jejuni. This causes diarrhea, and man, that sucks for anyone, but especially if you're trying to film a big-budget, highly anticipated film based on a property with legions of fans and great expectations creatively and commercially.
"So I was very, very ill for the whole production, and everything felt so barely in control because my body was failing me," Cregger explained.

Cregger said he credits his "wonderful, talented" department leads to help him through, while he also praised Resident Evil star Austin Abrams for going above and beyond. He said Abrams is "one of the most can-do, positive people I’ve ever met. I was spoiled by the people around me."

Not only was Cregger physically sick while making Resident Evil, he had to deal with freezing-cold conditions in the north of the Czech Republic where the movie was filmed. "We froze our asses off," he said.
This wasn't the first time Cregger was dealing with physical turmoil while making a movie. On his last film, Weapons, it was so hot and humid that he needed an IV and directed scenes remotely .

Resident Evil releases on September 18, and it's expected to have a huge, record-setting opening weekend . The movie stars Austin Abrams as a medical courier named Bryan who is an "idiot" everyman who finds himself in a world of pain.

news.title: Resident Evil Creator Shinji Mikami to Be Inducted Into D.I.C.E. Hall of Fame
news.summary: Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami will officially be honored with the Hall of Fame Award at the 30th Annual

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/mikami-1789583860592.png
Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami will officially be honored with the Hall of Fame Award at the 30th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards ceremony on February 18, 2027.

The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences (AIAS) announced the news today and shared that Grasshopper Manufacture's Goichi Suda (SUDA51) will present the award to his "close friend and creative collaborator."

“It was from Mikami-san that I learned how to approach game development, both as a director and as a designer. Of all the many Padawans Mikami-san has mentored, I’m truly honored that I was chosen to be his presenter for this induction into a kind of video game hall of fame,” said Suda. “As one such Padawan, please allow me to celebrate my Obi-Wan Kenobi, Shinji Mikami, through this honorable award. I’m sure Mikami-san’s innumerable fans and industry comrades are just as delighted as I am to see him receive such an amazing award.”
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/mikami-1789583803689.png

Mikami's career has spanned over 30 years and his catalog of games is nearly unmatched, including Resident Evil, Devil May Cry, Dino Crisis, The Evil Within, Hi-Fi Rush, Vanquish, Ghostwire: Tokyo, and many more.
He is currently the Creative Director and CEO of Unbound Inc., which was purchased by Stellar Blade developer Shift Up earlier this year and is currently working on an unannounced video game.

“Shinji Mikami is a monumental and influential figure for both fans and developers alike,” said Meggan Scavio, president of the AIAS. “He has continually demonstrated his originality and creative vision that resonates and inspires the action game genre. We are honored to be able to celebrate Mikami-san’s achievements and induct him into our Hall of Fame during our 30th anniversary of the D.I.C.E. Awards.”

Mikami will join such past AIAS Hall of Fame recipients as Evan Wells (2026), Ted Price (2025), Koji Kondo (2024), Tim Schafer (2022), Ed Boon (2021), Connie Booth (2020), Bonnie Ross (2019), and Todd Howard (2017).
For more, check out Mikami's thoughts on what makes a good remake and how it's up to developers to make games people want to play, not just stream.

news.title: Resident Evil Is Now The Highest-Rated Gaming Movie Ever
news.summary: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18.

content.v: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18. Reviews from critics went live today, and the movie is earning high scores. GameSpot's Resident Evil review scored it an 8 and said it successfully captures the breathless terror of the games.

In fact, it's now the highest-rated video game movie ever. It boasts a mightily impressive 96% on Rotten Tomatoes from 71 reviews and an equally impressive 80 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic. According to Metacritic , Resident Evil is the highest-rated video game movie ever, well ahead of another 2026 movie, Exit 8, which has a 71 Metascore.

The six Resident Evil movies that Paul W.S. Anderson made did not score very high with critics, with 2016's The Final Chapter topping them all at 49% on Metacritic. The latest Resident Evil movie before Cregger's, 2021's Welcome to Raccoon City from director Johannes Roberts, scored a 44% on Metacritic.

After that movie came out, Constantin, which has owned the movie rights to Resident Evil since the '90s, intended to put the franchise on hiatus . However, Cregger, coming off the success of Barbarian, pitched Constantin on his new, original take, and Constantin loved it so much that they put it into production.

Video game movies had a track record of mediocrity at best for years, but the tide is turning in recent times. This could be for many different reasons, but some have theorized that part of what made video game movies of yesteryear poor in terms of reception was that, in large part, the game studios and creative minds behind them were not involved in the development process.

That's changed now. Oliver Berben, the CEO of Constantin, said that while his team didn't contractually need to consult with Capcom , the film studio did so anyway to ensure it was respecting and caring for the IP and its fans.

That might be a surprise to some gamers, as many have voiced their concerns and dislike for Cregger's take on Resident Evil, in part because he's telling a new story and not adapting any previous games or featuring any of its characters.

Cregger said in press interviews that he felt like he was on an apology tour instead of a press tour due to the fan blowback. He's also admitted that he was naive to think fans would embrace him and his ideas, but ultimately he made the movie he wanted to, and it's clearly resonating with critics.

Nintendo, meanwhile, went further than many have in terms of Hollywood adaptations. The company was not only creatively involved in The Super Mario Bros. Movie and The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, but co-financed them. For 2027's The Legend of Zelda movie, Nintendo is putting up more than 50% of the funding , so it would seemingly get to call the shots.

This contrasts with the arrangement Take-Two and Gearbox had for the poorly received and commercial flop that was the Borderlands movie. Lionsgate funded it , not Gearbox or owner Take-Two, and it was the film company that paid the price for the flop, at least financially.
Resident Evil officially releases on September 18, but screenings begin on September 17. The movie is expected to have the biggest opening weekend ever for a Resident Evil movie .

The film stars Austin Abrams, who had a standout performance in Cregger's Weapons, as a medical courier who takes on a job that brings him to Raccoon City. Everything goes badly, of course, and Abrams himself nearly died for real making the movie .

news.title: Marvel's Wolverine Players Are Testing Its Motorcycle Sequence to See if Logan Can Die if You Don't Touch the Controller
news.summary: Marvel’s Wolverine has kicked off no end of debates on social media, with the latest of these centering around

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/22/ps-studios-blog-1784719617494.jpg
Marvel’s Wolverine has kicked off no end of debates on social media, with the latest of these centering around a chase sequence that sees Logan weaving through traffic on a motorcycle.

Insomniac’s new superhero game is the latest hot-button topic in the gaming community. Well before it even released, players were calling out early gameplay footage shown off by the media, taking umbrage with a Sentinel boss fight (it was too formulaic), its voice acting (who hired these anime voice actors for my grisly X-Men game?) and Logan following a scent trail to track down enemies (too hand-holdy).

Now that it’s finally out in the wild, players have had a swath of mixed opinions on the title; some are absolutely loving it and finding it a decent challenge, while others are disappointed by its combat, perceived lack of difficulty, and impossible-to-fail QTEs.

This last complaint has reared its head specifically around a sequence where players are meant to chase down enemies on a motorcycle, dodging and weaving through traffic on a winding highway in the mountains. Logan is desperately trying to rescue a group of captured mutants who’ve been shoved onto a truck, and the situation is dire — but some players have discovered that he’ll successfully catch up to the bad guys regardless of whether or not you actually pilot him in the right direction.

One of the most viral examples of this came from an X user named Clint Beastwood, who claimed to have put down his controller to see what would happen to Logan if he didn’t interfere. The result was Logan bouncing off of guard rails like a high-stakes game of pinball, somehow making his way through the sequence without dying.

However, it is possible for him to die after getting hit by on coming vehicles, though he’s paradoxically more likely to meet an untimely end if players actually take hold of the controller and try to help him avoid ending up like a bug on someone’s windshield.
He CAN die. You do not need to control the bike. https://t.co/76EI4lDAy8 pic.twitter.com/6mPKHnxNne

The resulting conversation has been a heated one; players are at odds with each other, with some finding this a comparatively small issue in a sequence meant to get players from point A to point B, while others, like YouTuber ChicoFilo, are calling the lack of player agency “just ridiculous.”
“This here is a total disgrace,” Brazilian influencer Eloohzinha said. “It's [a] QTE that you don't even need to press, it's a bike that you don't need to ride.”

Isso aqui é esculacho total. É QTE que você nao precisa apertar, é moto que voce nao precisa pilotar. É pérola atras de perola. Realmente, o prego no caixão foi esse wolverine. Ultimo jogo bom do estudio foi Ratchet And Clank e ja era. pic.twitter.com/hRUFzxmNDe
Decided to play Wolverine on the HARDEST difficulty and honestly it's been fun but this is just ridiculous 😭 #Wolverine #Playstation pic.twitter.com/fnoqSKazV6

“If Wolverine gets hit while on the bike, he can die. So you do need to control the bike. It’s posts like this that hurt real conversations around games,” popular YouTuber Mightykeef argued. “...if you can die, then it’s not autopilot. You need to control the bike, or else you can die and start over again. This type of on-rails segment happens in hundreds of action games.”

“Keyword being ‘if,’ when ‘if’ shouldn’t exist,” another user hit back. “There’s plenty of videos already out there showing players getting through the entire sequence without dying, regardless of difficulty.”
Keyword being “ IF “ when “ IF “ shouldn’t exist. There’s plenty of videos already out there showing players getting through the entire sequence without dying. Regardless of difficulty.

For now, players will just have to pick up the game themselves to form their own opinions on it. We at IGN gave it a six out of 10 , saying its “good character work props up flashy combat that wears thin over time.” (Personally, I’m enjoying the game so far, and haven’t been annoyed by scent trails or QTEs just yet. I also liked the Omega Red boss fight, which seems to have been tripping up quite a few players onine.)

news.title: Pirate Who Cracked Denuvo Games Like Resident Evil Requiem Plans to Keep Doing So Despite Being Sued
news.summary: A pirate known for cracking games that utilize the DRM software Denuvo is being hit with a lawsuit... but that

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/02/25/re9-postgame-br-1772061133503.jpg
A pirate known for cracking games that utilize the DRM software Denuvo is being hit with a lawsuit... but that isn't stopping them from continuing on.

For years, PC games have attempted to shield themselves from piracy with a DRM software known as Denuvo. The software is meant to be difficult to crack, with the hope that it will protect the game from becoming available for free on piracy sites around the time of launch. It does its job to a degree, as it took about a month and a half for Resident Evil Requiem to be cracked ... and it was achieved by a pirate known as voices38.

As spotted by GamesRadar , the pirate is now being sued by Denuvo, so long as the company can actually identify who they are. The company is working to unmask this anonymous pirate and there's likely hope that even if they aren't successful, the pressure of an investigation will maybe spook voices38 into disappearing. That's not the case, though. voices38 took to Reddit to issue a statement, telling fellow pirates that "all is fine" and "everything will continue as normal."

It's an interesting story, and one that only feels all the more relevant with the recent GTA 6 leaks , when a leaker obtained access to the build of the highly anticipated game and taunted Rockstar Games with various messages. Once the game was properly revealed, the leaker vanished, and as of a month later, there has been no word as to whether or not they've been caught. Whether they'll return to cause more chaos remains to be seen, but it is pretty evident that online hackers and lawbreakers are getting good at evading detection.
Whether voices38 can continue to crack these games and get away with it is up in the air, but they certainly think they can.

news.title: MindsEye 开发商 Build a Rocket Boy 可能终于要关闭了
news.summary: 多名员工在 LinkedIn 上表示，所有离开的人都将被解雇。
news.titleEn: MindsEye developer Build a Rocket Boy may finally be closing

content.v: MindsEye 开发商 Build a Rocket Boy (BARB) 似乎已经经历了另一轮裁员，这些最新的裁员可能是致命的，因为多人表示所有剩余员工都将被解雇。

自从 2025 年推出极其糟糕（但仍然奇怪地有趣）的动作惊悚片 MindsEye 以来，BARB 一直在苦苦挣扎，该工作室一再声称自己是破坏活动的受害者，这种情况变得非常奇怪。对这种叙述的坚持似乎在 BARB 和最初的 MindsEye 发行商 IO Interactive 之间造成了裂痕，后者最终放弃了整个事情；更新继续不断，包括承诺（但完全未能提供）“破坏证据”的可怕扩张，导致 MindsEye 业绩低迷，但多轮裁员以及员工对严重管理不善和未经授权的员工监控的指控也是如此。
总而言之，特别是考虑到视频游戏行业的残酷本质，《BARB》的糟糕结局似乎是不可避免的，而现在可能已经达到了这一点。
“不幸的是，我和《Build a Rocket Boy》的其他同事一样面临着裁员，现在正在寻找新的机会，”首席武器和道具艺术家 Adam Ridsdale 在 LinkedIn 上写道。
首席人才招聘合伙人 Dan Hawkins 也分享了类似的信息，他写道：“我怀着沉重的心情，与 Build a Rocket Boy 的其他同事一起举起我的绿色旗帜。我‘开放工作’，积极寻找新的冒险。”霍金斯补充说，他“将见证 BARB 直到最后一刻，帮助人力资源部门解决问题”，暗示“结束”即将到来。
高级视觉特效艺术家 Jason Waller 也指出了工作室关闭的问题：“与 Barb 留下的其他人一样，我的角色也被裁员了。”许多其他员工也报告了裁员情况，但没有提及裁员的更广泛影响，其中包括担任 BARB 音频主管的 Rockstar 资深员工斯图尔特·罗斯 (Stuart Ross)。
建造火箭男孩尚未就报道的关闭发表任何形式的公开声明，但看起来它可能终于走到了尽头。我已联系工作室征求意见，如果收到回复，我会更新。

news.title: GTA 5 的“成为名人”模组功能几乎很奇怪
news.summary: 我想成为明星。
news.titleEn: GTA 5's 'Become a celebrity' mod is almost weirdly fully featured

content.v: 我每天都在修改《GTA 5》，要么将其转变为 PC 版本的《GTA 6》，要么彻底破坏它。明天回来看看我对 Rockstar 的宝宝做了什么新的可怕的事情，或者看看我之前做了什么。
你可能听说过我现在是马克·扎克伯格。这是真实的。甚至无可争议。但有些不对劲——无论他走到哪里，扎克伯格酷原创都会被认出来。他是一个著名的，或者说是臭名昭著的人。当我在《侠盗猎车手 5》中的洛桑托斯闲逛时，即使我是 Facebook 模仿版的极其富有的所有者，也没有人认出我。
不再。我安装了“成为名人”模组（巧合的是，与“LifeInvader Business Mod”来自同一作者），目的是成为镇上的名人。与 LifeInvader mod 一样，它的功能集实际上相当令人印象深刻：该 mod 在不同的轴上衡量您的公众认可度和整体声誉，并允许您进行一些可重复的任务来改变两者。
当然，你一开始的名气为零，而你唯一能做的就是所谓的“Z-lister”演出来提高名气。这意味着：街头表演。这意味着：在洛斯桑托斯周围的不同地点进行超过 20 次街头表演，每次表演可为您带来约 500 美元和 0.5 名誉点（名誉点并不多）。这是相当艰巨的，并且由于飞行汽车、帮派战争等而变得更加困难。
而且，人们似乎并不欣赏它。当富兰克林站在市政厅的台阶上，用吉他弹奏他的心声时，只有他雇佣的保镖发出了掌声。在其他地方，洛桑托斯要么冷漠地看着他，要么忽视他，要么死了（因为危险，你看）。有时，为了公平地对待坚忍的人群，富兰克林的吉他弹奏动画不会触发，他的 15 秒表演将由他站着不动和做鬼脸组成。
不过我做到了。所有 20 场演出，最终让我登上了新的名誉顶峰，并接受了一种全新类型的演出：见面会。在洛桑托斯商业区一个阳光明媚的地方，我的粉丝聚集在一起崇拜我。他们欢呼、鼓掌、上下弹跳，而富兰克林则一动不动地站着，茫然地凝视着中距离。这就是全部内容。这是我应得的。
当我的大部分粉丝被一辆卡车撞倒时，活动结束了。

news.title: Wardogs Outpacing Arc Raiders and Helldivers 2 on Steam and Has Already Made More Money Than Marathon Across All Platforms to Date, Analysis Shows
news.summary: Breakout hit Wardogs is outpacing Arc Raiders and Helldivers 2 on Steam in terms of copies sold at launch, new

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/ss-672d7ce9debe7a3bcfa5feee5fccc3d8b482b13e-1920x1080-1789577487431.jpg
Breakout hit Wardogs is outpacing Arc Raiders and Helldivers 2 on Steam in terms of copies sold at launch, new data shows.

Bulkhead’s tactical first-person shooter released in early access form on Steam on September 10 and hit a peak of 428,666 concurrent players soon after, becoming one of the most-played games on Valve’s platform. It sold 1 million copies on day one and 1.25 million by day two. Bulkhead announced 2 million sales after just five days .

According to Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics , Wardogs is now up to 2.2 million copies sold on Steam, which means it’s outpacing Arc Raiders (1.7 million) and Helldivers 2 (1 million) when launch aligned on Valve’s platform.

Not only that, with approximately $70 million in revenue generated so far, Wardogs has already made more money on Steam alone than Bungie’s Marathon has managed across PC and console so far, Elliott’s data suggests. “It’s another reminder that, when it comes to live-service games, community trumps budget and pedigree,” he said.

The question now is can Wardogs maintain its momentum with both Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and GTA 6 around the corner. Both Arc Raiders and Helldivers 2 enjoyed huge interest months after release, and went on to sell many millions of copies. Wardogs still has a long way to go before matching both games longer term, but it’s worth remembering Wardogs is in early access, where it will remain for 1-2 years. A console version planned for 2028. “We are adamant that we do not want to be in Early Access for a long time,” its Steam page reads. Overnight, Bulkhead boss Joe Brammer said Season 2 will bring “lots of new content and changes” now Wardogs was entering the next phase of development.

“Wardogs‘ growth story is far from over,” Elliott continued. “It’s got some maintenance hills to climb and a strong roadmap to deliver on before it can dream of reaching the heights of, say, an Arc Raiders.

“But make no mistake: even if it never sold another copy, Wardogs is already a huge success. It’s a $40 shooter aimed at a slightly unfashionable audience that stuck to its guns and turned out bloody great.

“You can’t really replicate what Bulkhead pulled off here, but they knew exactly who the game was for, priced it fairly, built the community before launch (and actually talked to them), cut the PR nonsense, were authentic (to a fault at times), and made something cool.”

On that $40 price point, Elliott suggested Wardogs hit “the modern pricing sweet spot, sitting below the friction point of a $70 AAA release while capturing that chunky volume of players priced out of premium titles.”

User reviews are now ‘Very Positive’ after initial complaints around launch problems. That appears to be done and dusted now, with players getting on with the game and having fun. A number of gameplay clips showing Wardogs shenanigans have gone viral ( players are even avoiding Wardogs’ Lonestar faction over a perception that they seemingly attract the worst players and lose the most games ).

news.title: 《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》的精彩评论让我感觉害怕错过
news.summary: 我们又来了：一款新的《火焰之纹章》游戏获得了好评，我想这可能就是其中之一
news.titleEn: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s Fantastic Reviews Have Me Feeling FOMO

content.v: 我们又来了：一款新的《火焰之纹章》游戏获得了好评，我想这可能是我最终喜欢的一款。 《火焰纹章：财富之网》将于明天在 Switch 2 上推出，在 GameSpot 的姊妹网站 Metacritic 上获得了 89 分的高分（截至发布时）。目前，它在 Metacritic 的 2026 年最佳游戏排行榜上名列第 13 位。
此外，GameSpot 的《火焰纹章：财富编织》评论称这是“未来游戏要打破的新高点”。作为一个原本不打算购买策略角色扮演游戏的人，我现在正在重新审视自己。我有购买广受好评的《火焰之纹章》游戏的历史，尝试了大约五个小时，然后又转而购买其他游戏。 2019 年 Switch 上的《火焰纹章：三宫》尤其如此。

在此之前，我第一次涉足该系列是在 2013 年，当时我在 Nintendo 3DS 上玩《火焰纹章：觉醒》，如果你不认为我是在《任天堂明星大乱斗》中扮演马尔斯的话。这是我仍然在我的 3DS XL 上下载的游戏，它位于我床头柜的抽屉里。我曾多次尝试参与游戏，但几个小时后就停止了。再说一次，我并不不喜欢回合制动作，但由于某种原因，它永远不会完全连接。我显然属于少数派，因为火焰纹章觉醒基本上拯救了整个系列。
之前接触《火焰之纹章》系列的经历让我一直忽视《财富之网》，直到现在。我看到人们对 Switch 2 独占版的高度赞扬，感觉我可能会错过一款精彩的游戏。当然，我现在正在玩《亵渎》，在购买打折促销后，《最终幻想 7 重制版》正在等着我。但如果《Fortune's Weave》是一款最终引起我共鸣的《火焰之纹章》游戏呢？

news.title: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》开发者戏弄“以前没有人经历过的事情”
news.summary: 资深《使命召唤》开发商 Treyarch 即将完成《黑色行动 7》的工作，并转向下一个项目
news.titleEn: Call Of Duty: Black Ops Dev Teases “Something That Nobody’s Ever Experienced Before”

content.v: 资深《使命召唤》开发商 Treyarch 即将完成《黑色行动 7》的工作，并转向下一个项目，但那会是什么？这还有待观察，但 Treyarch 设计总监 Kevin Drew 在新的 Dev Talk 视频中表示，这可能不是你所期望的。
德鲁表示，Treyarch 在 2024 年的《黑色行动 6》和 2025 年的《黑色行动 7》的工作中“学到了很多东西”，并且“在我们这个时代尝试了很多东西”。
“但我们已经准备好创造一些新的东西，一些以前没有人经历过的东西，”他说。
这听起来有些夸张和极端，而《使命召唤》工作室绝对以宏大的主张而闻名。
Treyarch 创作的《黑色行动》系列于 2010 年首次推出，至今仍然是该系列中最受欢迎的品牌之一。不同寻常的是，《黑色行动》游戏在 2024 年和 2025 年连续推出，Treyarch 自己也承认确实担心系列疲劳。
EA 的《战地 6》销量在 2025 年超过了《黑色行动 7》，其中《黑色行动 7》跌至年度第五名，至少在美国是如此。在《使命召唤》的另一次重大调整中，微软宣布从今年的《使命召唤：现代战争 4》开始，使命召唤游戏将不再包含在 Xbox Game Pass 中。
Infinity Ward 正在主导《现代战争 4》的开发，不过与往常一样，动视的《使命召唤》工作室网络（包括 Treyarch）预计将为游戏的整体开发做出贡献。
一个与《使命召唤》相关的有趣传闻称，拥有《使命召唤》和动视暴雪的微软正在考虑让《使命召唤》工作室开发一款光环游戏。另一条传言称，微软可能“将 Halo 纳入动视暴雪旗下”，作为更大规模重组的一部分，以帮助 Halo 重新获得在 FPS 市场的主导地位。

news.title: Balatro 开发者 LocalThunk 在 Discord 上谈论 1.1 更新和倦怠后的生活：“我现在确实度过了制作游戏的最美好的时光”
news.summary: Balatro 1.1 更新推迟到 2026 年已经过去一年了。
news.titleEn: Balatro developer LocalThunk turns up on Discord to talk about the 1.1 update and life after burnout: 'I truly am having the best time making the game now'

content.v: 自从我们上次听说 Balatro 的 1.1 重大更新以来，已经有一段时间了，自从开发者 LocalThunk 将其推迟到 2026 年以来，几乎到了这一天。目前还没有任何迹象，但社区昨天确实看到了 LocalThunk，当时他突然出现在 Balatro Discord 中，让大家知道一切进展顺利。
LocalThunk 写道：“我很高兴泄密事件进展顺利。”他指的是他自己发布的有关 1.1 更新的调侃。例如：
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oUayrAW3szSCwi7Y4j9Tn3-1920-80.png
“我知道你们想尽可能多地了解 1.1，但我不能透露太多。我知道这花了很长时间，而且我已经完全超过了 2025 年的时间框架，但我保证我会以最适合我和最终适合游戏的方式进行烹饪。”
这可以追溯到 LocalThunk 在 2025 年发布的关于 1.1 版本延迟的消息，他在消息中表示，在 Balatro 的开发上花费了太长时间之后，他“彻底精疲力尽”了。长时间休息后，他“非常缓慢地”重新投入工作，更像是一个业余爱好开发者，避开最后期限，而不是“试图创造性地强迫事情发生”。他还对宣布 1.1 更新的 2025 年发布目标表示遗憾，他在新消息中重申了这一点。
Localtnunk 继续说道：“我理解这一定是多么令人沮丧，我希望我能回到过去，给自己一些理智。” “当时还是很热闹，我从来没有考虑过我可以让自己停下来，然后移动版问世后，我就精疲力尽了，有一段时间无法接触游戏了。幸运的是，事情已经改变了。”
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/put9UYbPkJyMPQweujDPH4-1920-80.png
因此，LocalThunk 表示他将继续时不时地出现在 Balatro Discord 中，向人们保证 1.1 更新仍在开发中，并且可能会发布更多“泄密信息”，但在准备就绪之前不会对发布目标做出任何承诺。他还明确表示，尽管知道人们可能会因漫长的等待而感到沮丧，但他不会加快进度：“我不希望这款游戏半成品而毁掉巴拉特罗，我也喜欢这款游戏，我想玩一款有趣的游戏，而不是一个仓促的糟糕工作。”
“我现在确实在制作游戏中度过了最美好的时光。过去一年的开发可能是我做过的最有成就感的工作，包括发布前的时间，当时它只是一个小爱好项目，”LocalThunk 总结道。 “我正在尝试尽可能保持离线状态，因为这对我来说很有效，但当 1.1 准备就绪时我会放松下来。”
根据记录，Balatro Discord 上的人们没有表现出 LocalThunk 担心的沮丧或不耐烦的迹象：大多数回复都对他做得很好表示高兴，并鼓励他慢慢来。一位显然是 Discord 的新人对开发人员的出现感到特别兴奋：
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kp9Pj6qGurpsMLjWsT5sr3-1920-80.png

对于渴望了解更新内容的 Balatro 负责人来说，LocalThunk 分享的不仅仅是上面的“四个小丑”花絮。主要观点都集中在这个 Reddit 帖子中：名为 Lunker 的 2 级优惠券、选择下一张优惠券的算法更改、蓝色赌注返工等等。不过，真正让我惊讶的是，LocalThunk 预计 1.1 更新将是这条路的终点：在 1.1 更新到来后，1.1.1 更新将随之而来，“根据玩家反馈进行平衡性调整和更改”。
“很可能就是这样，”他写道。 “别指望更多了。”他还确认巴拉特罗不会有多人游戏模式。
现在应该不言而喻，但无论如何我还是要说：Balatro 1.1 更新听起来会很大，但绝对没有迹象表明它何时到来。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/01/23/bo7-1769167660474.jpg
Call of Duty developer Treyarch has said it’s “ready to make something new” as it waves goodbye to two years of Black Ops games.

Treyarch led development on two Black Ops games back-to-back: 2024’s Black Ops 6 and 2025’s Black Ops 7. With Season 6 hitting Black Ops 7 on September 17, the developer has signalled it’s moving on to its next Call of Duty game.

“This is a bittersweet goodbye, but I think over the last two years, we've learned a lot,” design director Kevin Drew said in a new dev talk video . “We've tried a lot of things in our current era. But we're ready to make something new and something that nobody's ever experienced before. In the meantime though, I will see you all playing in Season 6 on September 17th.”

What this means, exactly, is unclear. Could Treyarch be talking about making a new Call of Duty game not in the Black Ops subbrand? Is Treyarch’s next Call of Duty not Black Ops 8? That would be something of a surprise, given Black Ops’ popularity and brand power despite Black Ops 7’s high-profile commercial struggles . Perhaps Treyarch is talking about doing something brand new within the Black Ops universe. My feeling though, is that this is indeed a hint that Black Ops may be given some time to rest, and that Treyarch has something different up its sleeve.

Yale Miller, co-studio head, added: “It’s been amazing to look back at the last couple of years, setting new benchmarks with Black Ops 6, delivering the biggest Black Ops game ever with Black Ops 7, taking huge swings with Omnimovement, Endgame, all kinds of innovation. We are extremely proud and extremely excited for what we were able to deliver.

“So, it's been amazing to actually also have a dialogue with all of you through regular comms, also through these dev talks, and we've been along with you every step of the way while we're delivering new innovative content. You guys have been grinding out camos, unlocking new things, the progression systems, the feedback. A huge thank you to our partner Raven and all the other studios that helped us here at Treyarch bring all of you all those maps, all that content, all those zombies experiences. It's been amazing.

“Really excited as well for everything Infinity Ward has been working on. They are clearly setting new bars. There's so much more of that game for all of you to see. We've had the privilege of taking part in a ton of playtests as well. We'll see you all online in Season 6 and in MW4. Thank you so much. It has been a privilege.”

Infinity Ward’s Modern Warfare 4 comes out later this year, but Activision has yet to say what will follow. It has an army of studios working on Call of Duty, which may need a shot in the arm from, say, Sledgehammer or Warzone developer Raven in the coming years. The question for parent company Microsoft and new Xbox boss Asha Sharma will be, how does Call of Duty once again hit the heights of yesteryear?

news.title: Resident Evil Director Zach Cregger Reveals His Pick to Play Lady Dimitrescu
news.summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed which actress he would cast as a live-action Lady Dimitrescu

others.title: Resident Evil Director On Who Should Play Lady Dimitrescu In A Resident Evil Village Movie

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/gettyimages-2202921818-1789572275525.jpg
Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed which actress he would cast as a live-action Lady Dimitrescu — and we think he's made the perfect choice.

To be clear, the iconic Lady D from 2021's Resident Evil Village does not appear in Cregger's upcoming Resident Evil movie, as it tells an original story. So, don't expect to see her or any other fan favorites up on the big screen. That said, Cregger is a self-confessed Resident Evil aficionado, and seems to clearly know who he'd cast if given the chance.

"Christina Hendricks," Cregger said, when asked his pick for Lady D while in conversation with Pedestrian.TV . "That feels about right to me. What do you think?" Well, speaking personally, that seems like a solid call.

The vampire-like Lady Dimitrscu stole the hearts of many Resident Evil fans back when Village launched, with many players attracted to her giant stature and femme fatale design. Countless pieces of fan art followed, some more erotic than others, and Capcom leant into her popularity by providing life-size cardboard cutouts of the character in video game stores.

Even though Lady D hasn't returned to the series (so far), she remains a firm favorite — and notably her costume could be unlocked in this year's Resident Evil Requiem , if you stumped up for the game's Deluxe Edition.

Could we see the character appear in a future Resident Evil film? While Cregger has taken flak from some fans for deciding to make an original take on the franchise, early buzz for the movie has been positive, and the box office projections look strong. Indeed, Cregger has already said he has ideas for potential sequels. Here's hoping Christina Hendricks is free.

news.title: 导演表示，《神鬼寓言》对 Xbox 的“DNA 至关重要”，帮助游戏免受困境
news.summary: Playground Games 开发的《神鬼寓言》重启工作已经进行了很长时间，并且是我们的一部分。
news.titleEn: Fable Being “Vital To The DNA” Of Xbox Helped Shield The Game From Hardship, Director Says

content.v: Playground Games 开发的《神鬼寓言》重启工作已经进行了很长一段时间，在漫长的开发周期中“保护”这款游戏的部分原因是该系列与 Xbox 的紧密联系。 《神鬼寓言》游戏总监拉尔夫·富尔顿告诉《卫报》，“我真诚地认为《神鬼寓言》是一款重要的游戏。”
“在漫长的开发周期中保护我们的是 Xbox 内部的许多人都认为《神鬼寓言》对该平台的 DNA 至关重要，”富尔顿说。 “我想更进一步说，这对整个视频游戏很重要。它提供了其他任何地方都不存在的元素组合。”
虽然《神鬼寓言》可能受到了“保护”，但其他 Xbox 游戏和工作室却不能这么说。在《神鬼寓言》的整个开发期间，Xbox 关闭了工作室、取消了游戏并解雇了员工。今年最新一轮裁员已经到来，微软裁掉了 1,600 名员工，并且还将再裁员 1,600 名。另一个休眠的 Xbox 系列游戏《Perfect Dark》尝试重新启动，但微软取消了该游戏并关闭了其开发商。
微软于 2018 年收购了 Playground。该工作室专门开发《极限竞速：地平线》赛车游戏，《神鬼寓言》是该工作室的第一款非极限竞速游戏。
Playground 在内部创建了第二个团队来开发《神鬼寓言》，富尔顿说：“从头开始组建团队是视频游戏中最困难的事情。”
Playground 正在接手 Lionhead，该公司之前开发了《神鬼寓言》游戏，直到微软于 2016 年关闭了该工作室。该系列主要系列自 2010 年的《神鬼寓言 3》以来一直处于休眠状态，因此粉丝们已经等待了很长一段时间了。
同样在采访中，富尔顿取笑了寓言故事的结局，称它“确实挑战你思考你是谁，并以真正的个人成本来权衡结果。”他表示，尽管行业指标表明，只有相对较小比例的开始游戏的人真正完成了游戏，但 Playground “不懈地追求游戏结局的质量”。
《神鬼寓言》重启原定于今年发布，但被推迟到 2027 年 2 月。富尔顿表示，推迟到 2027 年有助于避免“混乱”的窗口期，这肯定是指远离 GTA 6 的爆炸区。

news.title: 前 MS 工程师揭示了臭名昭著的“FCKGW”Windows XP 密钥背后的故事：“盗版者开始将密钥烘焙成图像，或者只是用记号笔将其写入 CD”
news.summary: “最合理的来源是 OEM 或硬件合作伙伴，他们提前收到了最终介质，以便他们可以运送 PC
news.titleEn: Ex-MS engineer reveals the story behind the infamous 'FCKGW' Windows XP key: 'Pirates started baking the key into images or just writing it on the CD with a Sharpie'

content.v: 前微软工程师 David Plummer 透露，他是 Windows XP 操作系统端产品激活系统的“主要作者”，因此他掌握了臭名昭著的“FCKGW”产品密钥背后工作原理的一些内部细节。你知道，当时似乎每一张盗版的、家庭刻录的操作系统 CD 副本上都写着这个。
没有线索吗？我也不。我完全不知道这种非法活动，并且我拒绝任何其他指控。无论如何，著名的（现已失效的）密钥的整体是 FCKGW-RHQQ2-YXRKT-8TG6W-2B7Q8，Plummer 认为它很可能是由 OEM 或类似机构泄露的，因为他们可以提前访问微软当时全新的全蓝色 XP 操作系统。
“您可能还记得，产品激活要求您拥有密钥，并且必须在线或通过电话激活它，”Plummer 开始说道。 “但微软拥有大型企业客户……这些客户不想激活每台离线电脑。”
据称，客户将获得一个 Volume Media 光盘映像，然后可以使用 Volume Key 对其进行解锁。为了确认此类安装的合法性，产品激活系统将检查光盘映像以查找仅存在于卷介质上的秘密 10 MB“二进制 blob”。有趣的是，这个数据块恰好是 Microsoft Bob 的加密版本。
“我获取了他们的光盘数据，并对其进行了多次压缩和加密，”普卢默说。 “请放心，它是加密的，即使在人工智能时代，也没有人能提取它。我真的只需要随机数据，所以我从预压缩的二进制图像开始，因为，私下里，我还年轻，不知道我是否可以信任 CryptGenRand。”
这是FCKGW-RHQQ2-YXRKT-8TG6W-2B7Q8的故事。我是操作系统方面Windows产品激活的主要作者。不是关键的数学——这些人实际上很聪明，脑袋很大，在进入你办公室的路上撞到了门框。我刚刚做了… pic.twitter.com/GyndVkzlHh 2026 年 9 月 15 日
“所以，如果你曾经在普通 XP CD 上尝试过 FCKGW 密钥，那是行不通的，”Plummer 继续说道，“因为你没有 Bob。但如果你在 1995 年有办法下载大型 ISO 二进制文件或复制 CD，那么所需要的只是密钥和光盘的副本。”
对于微软来说不幸的是，一个名为 Devils0wn 的盗版组织在正式发布前五周发布了完整的 Windows XP Pro Corporate ISO，以及有效的 FCKGW 密钥。一旦数学上有效的密钥与卷媒体数据检查相结合，Windows 产品激活就会跳过其余的验证过程，所以，看似合法的 Windows XP 安装就属于您了。
“然后盗版者开始将密钥烘焙成图像，或者只是用记号笔将其写入 CD，”Plummer 说道。至于密钥本身的来源，他推测“最可能的来源是 OEM 或硬件合作伙伴，他们提前收到了最终介质，以便他们可以在发布当天运送 PC。
“戴尔是最常出现的名字；由于后来的源转储，英特尔也被提及。很少有组织这么早就真正拥有 VLK [批量许可证密钥]，这就是为什么时机指向合作伙伴而不是随机的企业客户。”
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/v6jhkoCR8QNWTGgFqDXmj3-1920-80.gif
“但我不知道，”普卢默证实。 “想必是有人这么做的。”
此后，微软开始将 Service Pack 1 中属于泄露密钥的产品 ID 列入黑名单，而 Service Pack 2“使检查更加积极”，并开始阻止使用该密钥进行安装的更新。然而，Plummer 表示，有效的、未泄露的 VLK 继续与 XP 的 Volume Media 版本一起使用多年。
“运营失败在于媒体和其中一把钥匙在产品到达商店之前就离开了大楼，”普卢默总结道。 “一旦这两个部分公开，WPA 的硬件绑定就再也没有机会运行。”
有趣的是，Plummer 在评论中表示，他从未遇到过真正适用于 Windows XP 的密钥生成器，而线程中的其他人则推测当时可用的密钥生成器只是伪造生成部分并从列表中随机选择泄漏的卷媒体密钥。
啊，当时的互联网确实是狂野的西部，这是肯定的。不过，现在您知道为什么这种神秘的数字和字母序列能够持续这么长时间，并且后来在许多 PC 用户的记忆中根深蒂固。但不是我。我这辈子第一次见到，老师。诚实的。

news.title: Microsoft hasn't marched Fable to the guillotine because it's 'vital to the DNA' of Xbox, says the game's director
news.summary: Hurting Fable would be like hurting the Xbox brand itself, to hear Ralph Fulton tell it.

content.v: Microsoft, at this point, drips gore from head to toe. The megacorp has made a hobby of shuttering studios and laying off thousands of devs , in attempt after attempt to right the listing ship of its games business. No luck yet, on that front.

You might wonder how Playground's upcoming Fable reboot, in the works for a decade now, has evaded its parent company's reign of terror. In a chat with The Guardian , Playground co-founder and Fable director Ralph Fulton offered up a pretty simple explanation: Fable's just that important.

"I genuinely think Fable is an important game," said Fulton. "What has protected us over a long development cycle is that so many people within Xbox view Fable as vital to the DNA of the platform." That is to say, Fable is a potent Xbox brand, like Halo or Gears of War, and that's protected it from the chop.

It fits the pattern of Microsoft's studio closures. Though the end of studios like Arkane Austin (rest in peace), Tango Gameworks (before it was picked up by Krafton ) and others felt brutal, they didn't strike at the heart of that amorphous thing you might call the Xbox brand. It did not claim the life of any character you might see plastered on a banner or standee at a Microsoft Gamescom booth.

Honestly? I might not have instinctually put Fable in that bracket, but I can see why you might, and in that light I can believe that Xbox execs would be timid about hurting it. Fulton, mind you, doesn't just think Fable's importance starts and stops at Xbox: "I would go a step further and say it’s important to video games as a whole. It offers a combination of elements that simply doesn’t exist anywhere else." Ironically, I suspect that wider importance matters less to games industry execs.

news.title: 《火纹》新作获IGN 10分！故事线封神 越玩越精彩
news.summary: 《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》即将于9月17日发售，媒体口碑现已解禁，外媒IGN打出满分10分好评。

content.v: 《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》即将于9月17日发售，媒体口碑现已解禁，外媒IGN打出满分10分好评。
IGN 10分 ：杰作（编辑之选）
《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》将出色的战斗策略与经营管理完美结合，四位英雄各自精彩的故事最终交织在一起，共同构成了一款令人惊艳的RPG。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162007197386.png
总评：
《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》以我完全没有预料到的方式进一步拓展了系列的策略玩法。它从未满足于只让我成长为一名战场上的战术家，也不只是考验我如何在一场场战斗之间合理安排时间，而是将这两种体验以一种近乎完美的方式融为一体。
每当我以为自己已经掌握了游戏的节奏时，新的挑战便会接踵而至，同时还会提供更多需要学习和掌握的工具，让我寻找应对这些挑战的方法。四位英雄各自独特的剧情路线充满了令人意想不到的变化，让我迫不及待地想看看他们的旅程究竟会如何走向不同的方向，而最终在结局篇章汇聚到一起时，那种震撼感更是格外强烈。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162008017445.png
规划队伍在庞大地图上的远征路线，也成为了游戏中一个出乎意料的亮点。这套系统不仅让我逐渐沉浸其中，还通过不断扩展的玩法回报我的坚持——随着新的威胁不断出现，我也能够解锁更多指挥和调度军队的方式，并尝试始终掌控不断变化的战局。
无论是极具挑战性的战斗，还是复杂精细的经营管理系统，单独拿出其中任何一条路线都已经足够称得上野心十足，更何况游戏还将这些内容分别融入四位英雄的故事之中。然而令人惊讶的是，每当你带领这些魅力十足的英雄踏入竞技场，乃至走向更广阔的世界，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》反而会变得越来越精彩。

news.title: 又一款IGN 10分神作出炉！今日游民火热新闻大汇总
星巴克锁住户外桌椅 门店:有老人长期占座 无奈之举
news.summary: 据媒体报道，近日有网友反映，在四川南充一星巴克门店门口，部分座椅和桌子被铁链锁了起来。该网友在视频中吐槽声：“这个星巴克又…

content.v: 据媒体报道，近日有网友反映，在四川南充一星巴克门店门口，部分座椅和桌子被铁链锁了起来。该网友在视频中吐槽声：“这个星巴克又不是什么皇位，他还锁起来。”
视频显示，星巴克门口的座椅和桌子有部分被铁链锁住，桌上放有提示牌，并写着“仅供星巴克顾客使用，感谢您的理解”。对此，该门店工作人员回应称，拍视频的人是因为不满座位问题，才拍摄了视频。
该工作人员解释称：“你可以看到她的视频，晃的那一下，另外两边椅子是开了锁的，两个是空的她不坐。然后我们的伙伴马上去找钥匙，给他开第三个。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162318426686.jpg
他还表示，门店门口的这些座椅本来是给消费者设置的，但由于平时很多老人来这里占位，他们才选择上锁。
“特别是到下午，每天都坐满了老人，我们又不可能去推他，也不可能去赶他。如果发生了什么事，或者老人家一激动怎么办？”考虑到顾客的体验，他们起初在位置上放了提示牌，但这些提示牌不断被人损坏或者带走。且门店制作的单据都还在，做了15个提示牌，现在剩2个，老人家会把牌子扔掉，没办法。

news.title: 网红自称每天只用睡30分钟 直播频繁打瞌睡后遭质疑
news.summary: 据媒体报道，一名自称每天只睡30分钟的日本男子近日引发争议。有网友发现，他在直播期间多次长时间离开镜头，甚至开始在直播中小睡…

content.v: 据媒体报道，一名自称每天只睡30分钟的日本男子近日引发争议。有网友发现，他在直播期间多次长时间离开镜头，甚至开始在直播中小睡，因此质疑其“每天只睡30分钟”的说法。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162314321839.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162314401813.png
据报道，这名男子名叫堀大辅。他从12年前开始通过训练逐渐减少睡眠，最终成功将每日睡眠控制在30分钟左右。他坚称这不仅没有影响健康，反而让他有更多时间处理工作和生活，相当于“让生命延长了两倍”。他自称属于“短睡眠者”，甚至开设课程向学生传授自己的睡眠方法，并收取费用。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162314466476.png
为了证明自己的说法，堀大介从9月9日开始在YouTube上直播自己连续一周的生活，直播原计划持续至9月16日。不过，过程中出现的一些情况引发了观众质疑。
报道称，他直播期间曾多次出现画面或声音中断。9月13日，他接受约1小时按摩时，镜头看不到他的脸，直播声音也被切断，因此有观众猜测他可能趁机睡了一觉。当天晚些时候，他又长时间离开镜头，直到闹钟响起后才重新出现在直播画面中。随后，他还表示自己会开始在直播期间小睡，这进一步引发了网友对其“每天只睡30分钟”说法的质疑。
网友认为这分明就是睡觉，而堀大辅则重新定义睡眠，死死咬定只有“躺在床上的正式睡眠”才算睡眠。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162314573419.png
对于这一变化，他解释称，自己此前制定的睡眠安排“过于激进”，因此不得不增加小睡时间。他还表示，由于睡眠不足，自己在直播洗澡时甚至出现了意外暴露的情况。

news.title: 《血源》可能不会有续集或重制版，但雨伞怎么样？
news.summary: 虽然从不下雨，但对于《血源诅咒》的粉丝们来说却倾盆大雨，他们对 From Software 心爱的作品抱有希望，希望得到一些消息
news.titleEn: Bloodborne May Not Be Getting A Sequel Or Remaster, But How About An Umbrella?

content.v: 虽然从不下雨，但《血源诅咒》的粉丝们却倾盆大雨，他们对 From Software 心爱的游戏抱有希望，希望能得到一些消息。幸运的是，你可以用一把官方的《血源诅咒》雨伞来躲避失望的风暴，还有一些适合那些想要在衣柜里穿上灵魂风格时装的人的物品。

由 SuperGroupies 时尚品牌推出的 Bloodborne 系列包括雨伞、领带和领带夹套装、卡夹、笔记本电脑内胆包和书本封面。 “童年的开始”伞的外部有卡里尔符文的插图，内部有月亮存在的轮廓，漂浮在红月亮前，上方是白色的花田。尽管这是有史以来设计的最毫无意义的衣服，但如果您确实需要领带，您可以购买受玛丽亚女士启发的领带，并欣赏受粉丝最喜爱的猎人启发的图案。配套的领带夹是仿照她领带上的夜光花胸针设计的。
对于《血源》配件，您可以使用反映邪恶之血登记册的书本封面、印有卡里尔符文浮雕的卡夹，以及翻盖形状和巧妙地借鉴了标志性猎人帽的饰钉的笔记本电脑内胆包来完善您的造型。预购将于 9 月 15 日开始，这些商品预计将于 2027 年 4 月中旬发货。
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Bloodborne-fashion.jpg?w=636

https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/20260806_1730.jpg?w=636

https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/20260813_1903.jpg?w=636
以下是它们的费用明细：
虽然《血源诅咒》的重制版或续集目前看来不太可能出现——这可能是出于索尼方面的战略原因——但粉丝们可以期待未来的“R级”动画长片。 YouTuber 兼游戏玩家 Sean McLoughlin（绰号 JackSepticEye）担任制片人，他表示，他将这部电影视为一个充满激情的项目，忠实地复制了这款经典游戏。

news.title: 《火纹:万缕千丝》M站开分89 将成NS2最佳RPG之一
news.summary: 9月16日，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》媒体评分正式解禁，目前游戏在Metacritic以89分开局，多家媒体对本作的剧情设计、战术系统以及系列…

content.v: 9月16日，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》媒体评分正式解禁，目前游戏在Metacritic以89分开局，多家媒体对本作的剧情设计、战术系统以及系列创新给予了积极评价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162010597205.png
本文摘录部分媒体评分以及评测内容如下：
VGC：100分
VGC表示，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》是系列粉丝以及策略角色扮演游戏玩家不可错过的作品，对于首次接触《火焰纹章》或SRPG类型的新玩家来说，也是一个非常适合作为入门的选择。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162012192513.png
该媒体称，游戏中的四位主角各自拥有精彩的故事线，每个人物的经历都足以支撑一款独立的《火焰纹章》作品，而玩家能够在同一部游戏中体验这些内容，是本作的一大亮点。
VGC还表示，虽然游戏推出时间尚短，但其认为《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》未来仍有机会被认为是Switch 2平台最优秀的RPG作品之一。
Gamereactor：90分
Gamereactor给予本作90分评价，表示即使此前从未喜欢过《火焰纹章》系列的玩家，也可能会被《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》吸引。媒体认为，本作融合了系列经典战术战斗与现代化系统，同时加入更多策略选择和玩法可能性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162012359175.png
该媒体称，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》不仅是年度优秀作品之一，也是一款值得Switch 2玩家体验的游戏。
Gameliner：80分
Gameliner则给出80分评价，认为本作在传统《火焰纹章》公式基础上加入了新的设计思路。游戏通过四位主角以及相互关联的剧情线，为玩家提供了更加自由的叙事体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162012474374.png
不过，该媒体指出，游戏前期部分系统较为复杂，剧情展开也需要一定时间，同时部分角色和活动内容表现相对普通。但随着玩家逐渐熟悉各项机制，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》依然能够带来具有吸引力的策略RPG体验。
《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》是《火焰纹章》系列新作，围绕多位主角展开冒险，并加入全新的战斗与叙事机制。目前本作已在Metacritic平台获得89分媒体均分。

news.title: 购买 Nintendo Switch 2 版《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》立省 10 美元
news.summary: 今天是您以 10 美元的价格购买 Nintendo Switch 2 版《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》实体版的最后机会
news.titleEn: Save $10 on Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave for Nintendo Switch 2

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/untitled-design-2-1789570257624.png
《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》将于明天在 Nintendo Switch 2 上推出。这意味着今天是您在亚马逊和沃尔玛购买该游戏实体版节省 10 美元的最后机会。如果您想知道这款游戏是否优秀，您可以跳至我们的 10/10 评论，看看我们的评论家对此有何看法。但说实话，如果你想要实体版，今天就买吧，因为明天它就会涨到 79.99 美元。
《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》立减 10 美元（今天结束）
数字版在 Nintendo eShop 上的售价为 69.99 美元，并且在可预见的未来仍将如此。但今年早些时候，任天堂开始对实体游戏收取比数字游戏高 10 美元的费用，大概是因为实体卡带、打印和运输的成本比提供数据下载的成本更高。
为了应对这一定价变化，亚马逊和沃尔玛都对零售商采取了不正当手段，开始为实体版预订提供 10 美元的折扣，使定价与数字版保持一致。但一旦游戏推出，价格就会回到建议零售价——在本例中为 79.99 美元。
一般来说，预订可能是一个冒险的举动，因为在评论出现之前，你并不总是知道游戏是否值得购买，或者游戏发布并获得普遍共识。但现在，我们正处于一个美好的时间窗口，评论是实时的，游戏在亚马逊和沃尔玛上仍然打折。但是，再说一次，今天是最后一天。
《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》是一系列战术角色扮演游戏中的最新作品，提供动漫风格的艺术和故事、回合制策略游戏玩法以及深入的角色互动。人们喜欢这些游戏，并且有充分的理由——它们通常非常棒。
看来这个也没什么不同。 IGN 评论家 Brendan Graeber 在评论中总结如下：

“《火焰之纹章：财富之网》以我无法预料的方式建立在其战略艺术的基础上。仅仅让我成长为一名战场战术家，或者仅仅让我能够明智地管理冲突之间的时间，但两者都完美和谐，这永远不会满足。每次我转身时，我都会面临更多的挑战，并需要掌握更多的工具来克服它们。每个英雄的故事路径的许多独特的曲折让我渴望看到这些旅程与其他旅程的所有不同之处。在最后一幕中，规划我在一张宏伟地图上的探险活动成为了一个意想不到的亮点，它不仅让我着迷，而且在我试图掌控新出现的威胁时，通过继续扩展我可以指挥我的军队的所有方式来奖励我的坚持，其艰巨的战斗和复杂的管理系统的范围对于一条路径来说都是非常雄心勃勃的，更不用说跨越四条路径了——但不知何故，财富的编织只会变得越来越好。引导迷人的英雄进入斗兽场甚至更远的地方。”
听起来很漂亮，很漂亮，很好。

news.title: 网吧快变豪华洗脚城了 海鲜自助、泡脚按摩一条龙
news.summary: 曾经的网吧，可能是香肠泡面、烟雾缭绕和嘈杂键盘声的代名词；如今再走进一些网吧，却可能看到完全不同的场景：全场禁烟并配备新风…

content.v: 曾经的网吧，可能是香肠泡面、烟雾缭绕和嘈杂键盘声的代名词；如今再走进一些网吧，却可能看到完全不同的场景：全场禁烟并配备新风系统，餐饮从泡面升级到自助餐甚至海鲜，泡脚服务可以直接送到座位。
从“上网的地方”到“一站式休闲空间”，如今的网吧正在经历一轮明显的业态升级。数据显示，去年中国端游市场收入达到781.6亿元，与此同时，网吧行业年营收已经突破900亿元。曾经被认为正在逐渐消失的网吧，并没有退出市场，而是通过不断增加服务项目，重新寻找自己的生存空间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162303367271.png
在部分高端网咖中，传统休闲业态甚至被直接融入网吧。消费者不仅可以上网、打游戏，还能在座位上享受泡脚服务，部分门店还提供肩部按摩、水果配送等服务。一些门店甚至开始向“短期居住”方向发展。独立包间内配备床铺和一次性寝具，部分场所还提供淋浴、洗衣等设施，能够满足用户连续停留数日的需求。
对不少年轻人来说，网吧提供的已经不只是电脑和网络，而是一种相对低成本的“临时生活空间”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162303436120.png
二十年前，人们走进网吧，更多是因为家里的电脑还不够普及；而到了今天，电脑本身早已不再稀奇。网吧真正试图提供的，反而是一个能够同时满足娱乐、休息、工作和社交需求的场所。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162303506119.png

news.title: 评论：空之轨迹第二章 (PS5) - 很可能是有史以来最好的 RPG 续集之一
news.summary: 杆位。你们如何跟进我玩过的最好的 RPG 重制版之一？嗯，显然，你只是
news.titleEn: Review: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter (PS5) - Quite Possibly One of the Best RPG Sequels Ever Made

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/15/trailsinthesky2ndchapter-blogroll-1789507599548.jpg

《轨迹》系列的最大障碍之一是，当几乎每款游戏都通过多个后续条目相互关联时，如何向新玩家介绍它的世界。毕竟，最初的《英雄传说：空之轨迹》子系列仅适用于 PC 和 PSP 等较旧的掌上电脑。幸运的是，开发商 Falcom 去年通过出色的《空之轨迹》第一章重制版弥补了这一缺陷——最终，通过流畅的 3D 改造和更新的游戏玩法，以一种平易近人的方式从轨迹开始的地方开始。这款角色扮演游戏紧随《空之轨迹 第二章》的重制版，保留了原版的所有最佳品质，例如故事、支线任务和角色，同时对其视觉和游戏玩法进行了彻底改造，以适应现代标准。
《空之轨迹》第二章紧接着前作的结尾，讲述了我们活泼自信的女主人公埃斯特尔·布莱特。现在，她的养弟兼最好的朋友约书亚·布莱特突然回忆起自己的真实身份并失踪了，埃斯特尔决心找到他并将他带回家。它还深入挖掘并充实了第一章末尾发现的邪教启示。因此，它从一开始就给第二章带来了更大的赌注，但也具有让你投入的情感共鸣优势。

角色也同样滑稽，而且充满个性。埃斯特尔，呃，明亮的举止与约书亚现在沉思的心情形成了鲜明的对比。 《奥利维尔》中的两个戏剧迷和邪恶的布鲁布兰克在一场过度放纵的诗歌对决中展开对决，看看谁能压倒对方。观看起来非常有趣，而且由于添加了完整的配音，体验也得到了增强（而原版《空之轨迹》游戏只有战斗配音）。在这些天空重拍中，剧本和故事变得更加生动，埃斯特尔和约书亚的原创配音演员重新扮演了他们的角色。这感觉就像是一个完整的循环时刻，特别是对于从一开始就坚持使用 Trails 的粉丝来说。
第二章在故事结构和支线任务方面实际上是对原作的 1:1 忠实再现，因此你将在利贝尔王国周围奔跑，穿过与第一章相同的城市和地点。虽然这看起来像是重复，但您在续集中访问它们的顺序已重新排列。加上与之前的冒险完全不同的支线任务，这让这次旅程感觉不像是翻新，而更像是重访老家。
没有任何多个不同的故事情节与后来的作品交叉在一起，比如《Trails Beyond the Horizo​​n》和《Trails Into Reverie》，这些作品还附带了一个 Roguelite 地牢，所有角色都可以在故事之外互动。它对第二章有利，因为它不会仅仅为了获得新的东西而不必要地陷入额外的故事内容。这是一个精简的冒险，很容易遵循，没有多余的臃肿，一些后来的足迹条目会受到影响。
话虽如此，进入结局之前的最后一章的节奏有点迟缓，因为由于故事原因，你需要最后一次回溯到以前的地点。问题是，你之前解锁的几乎所有快速旅行点都消失了，你必须再次激活它们，这使得道路上的这个特殊的颠簸变得很困难。

然而，这些翻拍作品倾向于风格化的动漫风格的艺术方向，为熟悉的世界带来了更大胆的色彩和新的愿景。战斗阶段之间的过渡更加平滑，并且使用更多的摄像机角度和锐利的剪辑使攻击和工艺更具电影风格。你可以看到每个角色激烈的面部表情的特写镜头，他们大声喊叫并以原作中自上而下的精灵无法实现的方式进行攻击。新的角色模型和动画为故事增添了额外的生命力，无论是玩家在探索世界的过程中享受乐趣，还是与强大的敌人战斗，为自己的生命而战。
角色动画在游戏玩法和过场动画中看起来都不那么尴尬，而且在关键时刻，他们做了很多事情来增加更严肃、关键时刻的分量。除此之外，支配其世界的政治阴谋和动乱，以及你在该系列中进一步看到的内容的起源，感觉更充分地实现了。 《天空》第二章中的故事为埃斯特尔和约书亚的角色弧线的结束提供了一个美妙的动力，干净简洁，没有延长它们——这是其他主角在后来的《轨迹》传奇中遇到的一些问题。
调整框架

这款重制版受益于 13 款游戏和 20 多年的迭代，采用了之前的 Trails 游戏的现有游戏系统框架。虽然最初的版本是纯粹的回合制，但《第二章》大量借用了《黎明之路》条目开始的实时和回合制混合系统。你可以在战场上实时攻击敌人（快速战斗），将他们削弱并击晕他们以获得优势，然后立即过渡到主要的回合制战斗（命令战斗）。一些《踪迹》的纯粹主义者可能不喜欢混合战斗的改变，但这是让它从原来的版本中脱颖而出的最大改变。
《天空》重制版的一个显着区别是增加了勇敢点数（BP），这是在《冷钢传奇》中引入的——你可以通过致命一击、击晕敌人或击中击晕敌人来积累它们。根据你花费的 BP 数量，你可以发起勇敢攻击，其中包括盟友的后续攻击、协调的连锁攻击，或者像《女神异闻录》中那样的全面群体爆发以获得额外伤害。它使第二章的战斗比原作更具吸引力和爆炸性。
第2章还巧妙地将混合机制和BP机制融合并发展在一起。在黎明游戏中，如果指挥战以优势开始，范和他的船员只会投掷碎片来造成额外伤害。然而，当你在天空第二章中以优势进入它们时，你可以发动先发制人的勇敢攻击，让你以强大的勇敢连锁或爆发动作开始战斗。令人印象深刻的是，第二章不仅复制并粘贴了之前《踪迹》条目中的战斗机制，而且还进一步将其改进为更令人满意的东西。
BP还可以在快速战斗中以勇敢冲刺的形式消耗，这是一种强大的打击，会造成更多的眩晕伤害，让你更快地进入优势状态。这对于体型较大、击晕能力更强的敌人很有帮助，但需要进行战略权衡。由于《Brave Rush》使用 BP，因此您进入命令阶段时的 BP 会较少，这意味着您可能没有足够的 BP 来发起先发制人的 Brave Attack。像这样的让步妥协确保了战斗系统保持相对平衡和具有挑战性。

news.title: 《生化危机》电影口碑首曝：紧张感拉满 像在玩游戏
news.summary: 据 gamesradar.com 报道，扎克·克雷格执导的《生化危机》新电影首批反响已经出炉，整体评价相当正面。

content.v: 据 gamesradar.com 报道，扎克·克雷格执导的《生化危机》新电影首批反响已经出炉，整体评价相当正面。
这部新片没有把镜头对准游戏里的熟面孔，而是讲了一个新角色：医院快递员布莱恩（奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯饰）要把一件物品送到浣熊市综合医院，途中卷入一场可怕的疫情暴发，只能为活下去而战。故事被放在《生化危机2》的外围展开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162255013923.png
克雷格的说法是，影片更想转化“玩电子游戏的感觉”，而不是做一次直接改编。从首批反响看，这个选择似乎收到了效果。
Collider 的佩里·内米罗夫称它是“我看过的最好的电子游戏改编作品之一”，并补充说它“也是我看过的最好的恐怖喜剧之一”，让她意外的是片中有大量搞笑桥段，却没有削弱事态的紧迫感和恐怖感。
Fandango 的埃里克·戴维斯则形容，这部电影“与其说是对游戏的改编，不如说是一部让你感觉自己在玩游戏的电影”。他还提醒观众别纠结游戏里有什么、没什么，影片取的是游玩那些游戏的精神，然后放开手脚去发挥。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/16/small_202609162255108921.png
需要说明的是，以上都是影评人的个人观感，属于媒体转述的早期反馈，并非官方定论，也不代表影片的最终成片质量。
